title: SQL ORDER BY Keyword
text:
SQL
ORDER BY
Keyword



The SQL ORDER BY

The
ORDER BY
keyword is used to sort the result-set in ascending or
descending order.

The
ORDER BY
keyword sorts the result-set in ascending order
(ASC) by default.

ORDER BY Syntax

SELECT
column1
,
column2, ...
FROM
table_name
ORDER BY
column1, column2, ...
ASC|DESC;
